snippet.title: LOOPFANG TRAILER GAMEPLAY - [ - - DEMO RELEASED - - ]
snippet.description:
A snake roguelite where your body is your arsenal. Collect weapon segments, fuse matching neighbors into higher tiers, and reorder them until they react with each other. Then close a loop with your own tail: everything trapped inside dies.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5001400/LOOPFANG/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=community_share_teaser_v1
